capabilityHints.summary: A creator launches one canonical pool with an immutable initial premium and public throughput target; traders receive one predictable buy or sell LP fee for the whole block, sustained directional congestion reprices only the following block, and the fee permanently settles to base after launch.

components.summary: Soft Landing factory and one CREATE2-mined canonical Uniswap v4 launch hook.

project.summary: A temporary Uniswap v4 launch hook that prices completed directional quote throughput one block later, keeps each block's LP fee stable, and irreversibly returns to the base fee after the launch window.
project.title: Soft Landing
